lines: [whining, exasperated] And I have three hundred pages of notes!
Step one. NotebookLM. [warm] It's free, from Google. Drop everything in.
[proud] Step two. I turned your notes into a podcast.
[amazed, laughing] A podcast? Of my notes?!
[warm] Twenty minutes. Listen on the bus.
Step three. Fifty flashcards, and a practice test.
[encouraging] Step four. Your weak spots. Chapter seven, again.
[scheming, quiet] Okay. Last thing. You're small. You fit in my bag. [hopeful] Take the exam for me?
[softly, warm] You don't need me anymore. You know every answer.
[friendly] Send this to a friend with an exam this week. Follow next level social, and comment exam. I'll send you the setup.
